g:HTMLPanel.p: Searchable single and multiple selects, by Tom Select 2. Inherit org.gwtbootstrap5.extras.select.Select and org.gwtbootstrap5.extras.select.client.TomSelectResources.

d:Example.heading: Single select
d:Example.description: `Select<T>` takes its options from Java with `setOptions`. Strings and enums work as they are; `placeholder` shows while nothing is selected and `searchEnabled` filters as you type.

d:Example.heading: Multiple select, with objects
d:Example.description: `MultipleSelect<T>` keeps a list of values. For objects, `setItemProvider` says which value and text each option has.
